title_clean: F&O Traders Can Now Earn 3X Money - New Margin Rules by SEBI
summary: Walks through SEBI's new margining on real examples: naked ATM options now ~1.0-1.3 lakh (up from 80-90k), but hedged spreads collapse to ~25-35k, cross-margined straddles to ~1.05 lakh, straddle-with-wings to ~45-55k, and an ITM put calendar under 30k - pushing traders toward hedged, index, defined-risk structures.

Index exposure carries structurally lower margins (2% vs 3.5% exposure) - another argument to avoid stock options.

title_clean: Taxation for Trading Income - Intraday, F&O, Long-Term
summary: Tax primer: cash-market gains taxed at 15% STCG / 10% LTCG above 1 lakh (post-2018), while F&O profits are business income taxed at slab rates with full expense deduction. Compares individual vs corporate accounts: ~42% top personal rate vs 22-25% corporate, but MAT ~18% limits corporate loss set-off.
lessons: F&O income is business income: slab rates hurt, but expense deduction (broadband, office, salaries, depreciation) and loss set-off often win.
Individual accounts can carry trading losses forward ~8 years against future profits; corporate accounts face MAT (~18%) even in profit years, limiting set-off value.
Entity choice rule of thumb: large, consistently profitable capital -> corporate (22-25% vs ~42%); small capital or loss-prone -> individual.
Cash-market capital gains allow no expense deduction - flat 15%/10% - unlike business income.

title_clean: #AskPR 4 - Second Wave of Selling, FII Data During Market, Weekly Hedges
summary: Q&A: debunks the short-selling 'ban' (practical cap ~500 crore plus margin), warns against 2008-pattern confirmation bias with the market at record highs, explains weekly-hedge rollover mechanics, options-vs-futures collateral treatment for MTM losses, margin-shortfall penalty slabs, and tells small-capital traders to avoid F&O.
lessons: Confirmation bias: when you want a crash you will find reasons - trade the market that is, not the pattern that 'should' repeat.
Options-seller MTM losses can be adjusted against collateral until booked; futures MTM must be paid in cash daily - know which instrument your capital can carry.
Squaring only the hedge leg instantly recreates a naked position: margin shortfall penalties run 0.5%/day (<1 lakh), 1%/day (>1 lakh), 5%/day from the sixth session.
There is no holy-grail directional formula in open interest - only guidelines plus experience.
With 40-50k capital, F&O is a losing game by structure - buy mutual funds instead.

title_clean: Escaping Market Risks - June 8 Market Report
summary: Euphoric gap-up morning (Nifty +200, Bank Nifty +500) fizzled: pre-market blog call that Nifty future would break 10,200 at least once played out; session closed as a Doji via the weighted-average close; RBI nod for IndusInd open-market buys lifted it early while HDFC/Kotak/Reliance were sold hard from highs; FII +813 cr vs DII -1,238 cr; view: consolidation with positive bias, supports 9,900/9,700.
lessons: Euphoric gaps attract profit-booking: 'a bull market dies of euphoria' - fade the open, respect the close.
The printed close is a last-half-hour weighted average - comparing it to yesterday's true close can fake a 'Doji' or fake momentum.
When a stock sets all-time highs and is still sold into strength, the positives are priced - supply beats narrative.
Stated supports belong to risk classes: 9,900 for aggressive traders, 9,700 for moderate - sizing follows the classification.
